The algebraic group is split and simply connected over \(\overline{\mathbb F}_p\), where \(q\) is a power of \(p\). The pinned diagram automorphism \(\gamma\) has order \(3\) and cyclically permutes the three outer nodes of the \(D_4\) diagram. It commutes with coordinatewise Frobenius \(F_q\), so \(F^3=F_{q^3}\). Multiplication is multiplication of cosets of the finite center.
